observable_diagnosis: The received guidance stated that both chair bases were above the floor; no student pre-repair contact measurement is visible. The student read the original construction, then measured the revised wheels: evaluated minima and a separately sampled local support height were both 0.015 to five decimal places for all ten wheels. Evidence: evidence/received_guidance.txt:1-3; evidence/sdk_events.json events 0-2, 13-19. The teacher's original aggregate gap of 0.015 is a prior, not student discovery (evidence/teacher_diagnosis.json:2-10).

candidates.hypothesis: Reorient wheels and revise the spokes/forks while keeping the chair body at its original height; choose wheel bottom at the nominal plank top.
candidates.observed_result: Rebuilt scene and render saved; all ten evaluated minima and center-based floor ray heights print 0.015. A side render was read. Independent evaluator geometry also records tiny support gaps within its 0.0001 tolerance, not a student measurement (evidence/target_geometry.json:8458-8635).
candidates.side_effects: Spoke elevation and wheel silhouette changed; camera framing and door color also changed in the same build. Seat and post source heights stayed fixed.
candidates.unvalidated_parts: No controlled comparison against whole-assembly alignment, no mesh-distance test for all wheel/fork and post/shell connections, and no proof of absence of all penetration from one center ray per wheel.

candidates.hypothesis: A compact one-line ray-cast expression can test support beneath every wheel.
candidates.observed_result: SyntaxError before the expression ran despite Blender exit code zero; no contacts printed.
candidates.unvalidated_parts: This variant produced no ray measurements; it was replaced by a multiline check.

candidates.hypothesis: A multiline downward ray at each wheel center can sample local support height.
candidates.observed_result: Ten bottom/support pairs print 0.015 after rounding.
candidates.unvalidated_parts: Hit object and full wheel footprint are not reported; wheel bottom is computed from the known radius rather than sampled at the ray hit.

exploration_assessment.explanation: One combined modeling candidate was built. The student added evaluated-wheel minima, local center rays and a side-view inspection, but did not execute a separate whole-assembly repair or compare alternative reconstructions. A failed and corrected ray expression are verification attempts, not distinct modeling paths. Camera and door changes confound visual before/after attribution.

failure_or_stopping_observations: First floor-ray expression failed with a mismatched parenthesis despite exit code zero; the later multiline expression produced results (evidence/sdk_events.json events 16-19; evidence/executions/blender_1795799699991182445/stderr.log:1-4).

The side image was read but the trace records no detailed finding about individual junctions; the final claim of all connections being inspected is not equivalent to a measured junction test (events 20-24).
The evaluator's regenerated and checkpoint scene states are independent outputs, not student regeneration or verification (evidence/scene_states/state_open_results.json).

candidate_knowledge.problem: Chair wheels appear unsupported above a reconstructed plank floor.
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: Received guidance reports both chair assemblies above the floor; the prior diagnostic reports aggregate minimum z 0.030 versus listed floor z 0.015.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Unrotated wheel cylinders' vertical extent and fixed placement leave clearance; whole-assembly misplacement is a competing prior, not a measured branch conclusion.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Rotate each caster cylinder to a horizontal axle, set its center to plank height plus radius, raise spoke ends and add fork bars; check evaluated wheel minima, local center rays, and a side render.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: This scene's planar plank tops and known wheel radius; transfer to uneven floors or other scenes is untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Student measurements agree to five decimals for ten wheels; independent evaluator reports near-zero sampled floor gaps. Side image was read but detailed junction findings are not recorded.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Wheel and spoke silhouettes change; camera and door material were independently edited in the same build.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: No alternative repair comparison, full wheel-floor intersection test, exhaustive structural junction measurement, or cross-scene test.

limitations: Reference images provide no hidden ground-truth geometry.
The student measurements are post-repair and use a hard-coded nominal height and center-based rays; rounded equality is not a comprehensive collision or physical stability test.
Independent evaluator files establish scene facts only and are not evidence of student actions. No full-reference image plane is shown in the executed source.
Only the actually received guidance is attributed to the student; the fuller teacher diagnosis contains additional unreceived proposed methods.
